title: Feet ease over steps and edges
notes: In the walk and run previews, the hips now settle onto and off a slope at the same pace as the feet, so the downhill foot no longer lifts for a moment where the ground starts or ends.
A stone lip passing under a foot now lifts that foot over a few frames instead of in one jump.
Standing on a rock or ruin on gentle ground no longer plants your feet on the sand inside it.
Try it with WAR_WALK_CYCLE=1 or WAR_RUN_CYCLE=1. Ordinary launches move exactly as before.
